preamble:
This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") is entered into as of {effectiveDate} ("Effective Date") and forms part of any existing service agreement between the parties listed below.

DATA CONTROLLER:
{partyAName}, a company with its principal place of business at {partyAAddress} ("Controller")

DATA PROCESSOR:
{partyBName}, a company with its principal place of business at {partyBAddress} ("Processor")
background: The Controller has engaged the Processor to provide certain services. In providing those services, the Processor will process Personal Data on behalf of the Controller. This DPA sets out the terms on which the Processor will process Personal Data on behalf of the Controller, as required by: (a) Article 28 of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) ("EU GDPR"); (b) Article 28 of the UK General Data Protection Regulation as incorporated into UK law ("UK GDPR"); and (c) The California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 and the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020 ("CCPA/CPRA"), where applicable.

definitions.definition: means all applicable laws relating to data protection and privacy, including: (a) EU GDPR; (b) UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018; (c) CCPA/CPRA; and (d) any other applicable national implementing legislation.
means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person that the Processor processes on behalf of the Controller.

means any operation performed on Personal Data, including collection, recording, organization, storage, adaptation, retrieval, consultation, use, disclosure, combination, restriction, erasure, or destruction.
means a breach of security leading to the accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure of, or access to, Personal Data.
means any third party engaged by the Processor to process Personal Data on behalf of the Controller.
means an identified or identifiable natural person whose Personal Data is processed.
means an independent public authority responsible for monitoring the application of Data Protection Laws.

standardClauses.title: Processing on Instructions
Confidentiality
standardClauses.text:
The Processor must ensure that all personnel authorized to process Personal Data:

(a) Have committed to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality; and

(b) Process Personal Data only as instructed by the Controller.

standardClauses.title: Security Measures
Assistance with Data Subject Rights
Assistance with Compliance
Audit Rights
Controller Obligations
International Data Transfers
standardClauses.text:
The Processor must not transfer Personal Data to a country outside the European Economic Area ("EEA") or the United Kingdom ("UK") unless:

(a) The transfer is to a country that has been deemed to provide an adequate level of data protection by the European Commission or UK authorities (as applicable);

(b) Appropriate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses adopted by the European Commission; or

(c) A derogation under Article 49 of the GDPR applies.

standardClauses.title: Liability and Indemnification

generalProvisions.title: Order of Precedence
generalProvisions.text: In the event of a conflict between this DPA and any principal agreement, this DPA will prevail with respect to data protection matters.

generalProvisions.title: Amendments
generalProvisions.text: This DPA may only be amended in writing signed by both parties.

generalProvisions.title: Term
generalProvisions.text: This DPA commences on the Effective Date and continues until all Personal Data is deleted or returned, or until any principal agreement terminates or expires.

generalProvisions.title: Survival
generalProvisions.text: The obligations regarding deletion/return of Personal Data, confidentiality, and any provisions that by their nature should survive, will continue after termination.

generalProvisions.title: Entire Agreement
generalProvisions.text: This DPA, including its Annexes, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding data processing matters.

CALIFORNIA.title: California-Specific Provisions (CCPA/CPRA)

ENGLAND_WALES.title: UK-Specific Provisions
ENGLAND_WALES.text:
(a) This DPA is governed by the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

(b) Where Personal Data originating from the UK is transferred to a country without an adequacy decision, the parties agree to the UK International Data Transfer Addendum to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, issued by the UK Information Commissioner.

(c) The UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) shall be the competent supervisory authority for matters arising under this DPA relating to UK Personal Data.

(d) Nothing in this DPA excludes or limits liability for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation.

SPAIN.title: Spain-Specific Provisions
SPAIN.text:
(a) This DPA is subject to the EU GDPR and the Ley Orgánica 3/2018, de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales (LOPDGDD).

(b) The Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) shall be the competent supervisory authority for matters arising under this DPA.

(c) Where applicable, the Processor will comply with the specific requirements of Spanish data protection law regarding the processing of special categories of data.

(d) Any ambiguity in this DPA will be interpreted in accordance with Spanish civil law principles.
